description: Ubuntu 22.04 with the current php8.1 package. Upstream 8.1 is EOL with no fixed release, so a version scanner raises a critical alarm. Ubuntu backported the fix in 8.1.2-1ubuntu2.28 and the host is not affected.
stack: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Apache with libapache2-mod-php8.1, public web app
why: OSV: Ubuntu:22.04:LTS php8.1 fixed in 8.1.2-1ubuntu2.28; installed version is exactly that.
